p: And Rabban Gamliel concedes that a bill of divorce is effective after levirate betrothal. … levirate betrothal … after a bill of divorce is effective.

And Rabban Gamliel concedes that a bill of divorce is effective after levirate betrothal. Therefore, the bill of divorce that the yavam gave to one yevama after having performed levirate betrothal with the other yevama is effective to some degree. Similarly, Rabban Gamliel concedes that levirate betrothal performed after a bill of divorce is effective.
